blind.description: A freestanding section of a beige limestone or sandstone wall featuring a pointed Gothic arched window with decorative stone molding and vibrant diamond-paned stained glass. The wall has carved horizontal stone courses and a rounded top cornice. The stained glass features colored panes in red, green, yellow, orange, and blue set within stone tracery, visible from both sides. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A narrow, horizontal rectangular pale-yellow bar with slightly rounded edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 to 6.5 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
